notes.subject: וישאלום
notes.rationale: Hiphil of שאל: 'they caused them to ask' or 'they granted what was asked'; KJV 'lent' vs JPS 'let them have what they asked'.

notes.subject: וינצלו
notes.rationale: 'They stripped/plundered the Egyptians' vs 'they delivered/rescued them'; context favors plunder, rendered 'oipeʼa ... tembireko'.

notes.subject: tembireko
notes.rationale: Hebrew says only 'they plundered Egypt (the people)'; 'tembireko' (goods) supplied to make the object of plunder explicit.

translation: Ha Jahve omeʼẽ ⟨את⟩ tavayguakuéra ijehechaporã Mitsraim-yguakuéra resaikuéra pepýpe, ha upévare omeʼẽ hikuái ojerurehápe; ha upéicha oipeʼa hikuái ⟨את⟩ Mitsraim-yguakuéra rembireko.
